source_summary: Chinese landscape painting with layered ink-wash mountains, willow groves, pine-dotted slopes, open spring pasture with grazing cattle and a shepherd, foreground trees, rocks, and shallow water. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: layered_distant_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the pale blue-gray and tan distant hill chain across the left and center background, including the soft receding peaks behind the nearer ridge and the misty gaps between them.
must_preserve: soft blue-gray washes on far peaks
thin contour lines on nearer low ridges
small dotted vegetation along ridge crests

motifs.name: high_right_mountain_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper-right mountain mass with sweeping diagonal ridges, rounded summit, dark vegetation dots, and dry-brush texture, excluding nearby calligraphy on the far right.
must_preserve: dark ink-dot tree clusters along crests
pale ochre and gray wash texture
soft mist transition at lower slope

motifs.name: mid_right_pine_terraces
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right stand of dense upright trees and the adjacent terraced field bands beneath the mountain slope.
must_preserve: small dotted shrubs at field edges

motifs.name: central_willow_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the broad midground willow grove stretching across the lower mountain base, with arched bare branches, low shrubs, and pale spring greenery.
must_preserve: transparent wash around the grove edges

motifs.name: open_pasture_grazing_herd
motifs.description: Isolate the open lower-left and central pasture with scattered grazing cattle, pale green meadow marks, and low field contours, excluding the seated figures at far left.
must_preserve: individual cattle outlines in fine ink
spacing between animals across the field

motifs.name: shepherd_with_oxen
motifs.description: Isolate the small shepherd figure holding a stick among grazing oxen on the mid-right meadow.
must_preserve: tiny shepherd hat and robe outline
light brown and gray animal washes
small green grass dabs around the feet

motifs.name: left_foreground_tree_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground leafless tree group with exposed trunks, nearby rocks, and the two small seated scholar figures beneath it.
must_preserve: small scholar robes and seated postures
rock outlines at the tree base
dark ground dots and grass marks

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_grove_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground cluster of leafless trees, turquoise-green bamboo-like foliage, rocks, and shallow water/stream edge at the base of the slope.
must_preserve: thin water-edge lines and pale wash

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
